name: window
description: Read the current ZCode window state.

evidence: Derived from the previous local ZCode CLI verification record.

execution.expression: (async (args) => { const chrome = await window.zcode.getDesktopWindowChromeState(); const zoom = await window.zcode.getDesktopZoomLevel(); const overlay = await window.zcode.getWindowControlsOverlayMetrics(); return {maximized: chrome.isMaximized, supportsNativeRoundedCorners: chrome.supportsNativeRoundedCorners, zoomLevel: zoom.zoomLevel, leftPaddingPx: overlay.leftPaddingPx}; })
